HelloPlanet v1.4.0 - Windows portable release

Extract all files, then double-click HelloPlanet.exe.
The app runs in the system tray without a console window.
Left-click or right-click the planet icon to open the menu.

Choose a satellite, refresh interval, wallpaper display style, or language.
Use Fit to display the entire image; Fill may crop the image to fill the screen.
Progress and errors are visible in the menu and tooltip.
Force refresh is disabled while a download is running.
Settings are retained after restart. Only one instance runs at a time.

Network access is required. Logs are opt-in from the menu.
The ZIP contains the executable, checksum, and optimization report.

Source: https://gitee.com/yinxiaolong007/hello-planet-earth
